title: ClaimArbitrage fails when SYA distributes tokens not in knownStables -- tokens permanently locked
description: Step 5 loop only iterates knownStables[]. If SYA's claim() distributes a stablecoin not in knownStables, the token remains trapped in the CA contract with no conversion path and no rescue function.
impact: Tokens permanently locked in ClaimArbitrage. The cross-contract configuration between SYA's yield strategies and CA's knownStables can fall out of sync. No recovery mechanism exists.
attackPath: SYA adds a new yield strategy that distributes a stablecoin not in CA's knownStables[]
ClaimArbitrage.execute() calls SYA.claim(), receiving the unknown stablecoin
Step 5 loop iterates only knownStables[], skipping the unknown token
Unknown stablecoin remains permanently locked in ClaimArbitrage contract
No rescue or sweep function exists to recover the funds
recommendation: Add validation that all SYA strategy tokens are configured before executing, or add an owner-callable rescue/sweep function.
